name: Shop Utilities
description: A metal shop's utilities (shop-utilities): the compressed air (air-compressor - load / unload by its band, the receiver), the process chiller (process-chiller - the baths' cooling coils' heat), the wastewater neutralization (wastewater-treatment - the rinses' acid, the caustic / acid dosing), the DI water (di-water - its conductivity, the columns' regeneration); by the shift and the line; their electricity of the day. The metal shop of the demo.
